item.tib: spyi spungs gsang ba thugs kyi brnag pa gsas mkhar rin po che bka' brgyad gsang ba 'dus pa'i tshom bu tshogs kyi sgrub pa'i gsang sngags yan lag so drug gi stong thun seng 'joms rkang pa brgyad pa'i gad mo
item.coloph: gsang ba sngags kyi bshad tshul 'di ltar spyir g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa'i bdag po sman ri'i mkhan chen nyi ma bstan 'dzin dang / mchog chen kun grol grag pa'i (grags pa) bzhi pa bstan 'dzin tshul khrims grags pa sogs skyes chen du mas yang nas yang du gsung gsang spyi bor reg cing*/ lhag par snyigs dus rgyal ba gnyis pa rang gzhan grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho pha rol du son pa'i ris bral bstan pa'i bdag po 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya na sprul sku'i bye ba phrag brgya'i khyu mchog 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i mi shig g.yung drung 'byung gnas rtsal yongs su grags pas phyogs kyi mu khyud khyab pa'i bdag nyid chen po de yi zhal snga nas/ khyed rang bon lugs 'di la rang rkang tshugs pa'i theg rim tshig don dwangs shing stobs che ba rgya cher mchis mod kyang / mkhas grub gong ma rnams gshegs snga/ bar du phebs pa rnams kyis zhib dpyod ma thub pa'i skyon kho nas/ phyag len hrob hrob tu song gshis/ khyod kyis de lta bu'i tshul ma yin par bon rnying lugs bru yi phyag len bzhin/ gyer spungs chen po'i bka' srol 'di'ang 'grigs phyogs che shos lags na/ de lta bu'i gsang sngags bshad sgrub kyi phyag len khungs btsun pa'i rgyun zhig tshugs na/ phyi 'byung g.yung drung bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs rgya cher 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel bzang po'i btsas su 'gyur ba'ang srid pas/ de lta bur byung na dus kyi smin yon bsam las 'das shing / de la snyom las dang le lo dang gzhan dbang ma shor bar 'grub par gyis shig gi bka' rtsal bslab ston gzengs bstod kyis mtshams sbyar/ bslu med gsung gi byin gyis brlabs shing bka'arjes su gnang ba la gzhol ba dang*/ nye bar shwaka rigs 'gro 'dul grags pas yang nas yang du bskul bar brten te/ rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis 'chi med g.yung drung bkod pa'i khang bzang du brtsams par/ yi ge dang po'i ri mo mkhan phrin las lhun grub shes rab dpal bzang po'i (pos) bgyis pa dge legs su gyur cig/
